reviews.title: AI features are terrible
reviews.text: I specifically got this app for the AI features and they are worse than just using ChatGPT. For example, if you try to apply a tan or replace something in a photo using a prompt, it will give you completely ridiculous things. I was editing a full body photo of a person and it replaced both legs with a huge white object instead of just removing some shadows from the legs. You can try the same thing over and over again, but you just keep getting crazier and crazier results. The AI features in this app don’t work. It’s just a basic photo editor.
